# Design system — measured baseline

**Date:** 2026-08-30 · **Part 62** · Registers generated by
`~/.claude/skills/apple-design/scripts`. Every figure below comes from a script
or a register file, not from reading the CSS.

## Why this exists, and what it is not

Part 62 asks for thirteen design-system documents. The brief's list of thirteen
titles is not recorded anywhere in this repository, and inventing thirteen
plausible headings would produce documents nobody asked for. What a visual
rollout actually needs first is a **measured baseline** — you cannot say a
redesign improved anything without one. That is what this is.

If the original list of thirteen exists, this baseline is the input to it, not a
replacement for it.

## Token inventory

`token-inventory-connected.csv` · `token-inventory-pw.csv`

| | connected-frontend | Planning Workspace |
|---|---|---|
| distinct literals | **768** | **421** |
| occurrences | 2070 | 1150 |
| colour | 222 distinct / 513 | 161 distinct / 430 |
| spacing | 463 distinct / 1263 | 222 distinct / 603 |
| radius | 44 distinct / 226 | 13 distinct / 74 |
| shadow | 15 / 18 | 6 / 6 |
| z-index | 13 / 15 | 8 / 9 |
| duration | 7 / 31 | 5 / 21 |
| **font-size** | **4 distinct / 4** | **6 distinct / 7** |

The font-size row is the interesting one. Four raw literals across a 19,000-line
file means the **type scale is already fully tokenised** — everything else goes
through `var(--fs-*)`. Colour, spacing and radius are not: 222 distinct colours
against a palette of roughly 30 semantic tokens is the gap a rollout has to
close, and 463 distinct spacing values is the largest single number in the table.

These are counts of raw literals, not a defect list. Some are legitimately
one-off. The number to move is the ratio of literals to token references, and
this file records where it started.

## Contrast register

`contrast-register-connected.csv`

```
  COVERAGE — this is the number to quote, not just the failures
    files scanned      1
    pairs enumerated   218
    appearance contexts 3: (prefers-contrast: more), default, print
    interaction states  7: active, active+disabled, disabled, disabled+hover, focus+hover, hover, resting
    unresolved          721  (pairs this tool could not build — you must pair these by hand)
```

**Read the coverage line before the result line.** 721 pairs could not be built
by the tool at all — it cannot resolve `color-mix()`, `data-theme` blocks, or
inline styles, and this codebase uses all three. "0 failures" would describe
what was measured, not the artifact.

Of the 51 FAIL rows in the register, every one classified by hand against the
CSS. The counts are rows, and they sum to 51:

| class | rows | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| boundary-advisory (borders, WCAG 1.4.11) | 37 | advisory, not G1 text contrast |
| disabled controls | 4 | exempt under WCAG 1.4.3 |
| foreground identical to background | 4 | **tool mis-pairing** — `.btn-out:hover` is `background:var(--dark); color:white`, genuinely 16.6:1 |
| `rgba()` overlay read as opaque | 4 | **artefact** — `.dash-sec-hero` is a 3.5%-alpha gradient over white |
| CSS variable resolved to its high-contrast override | 1 | **artefact** — `.cal-chip.rescheduled`, whose own comment records 5.23:1 |
| decorative 1px rule treated as text | 1 | **artefact** — `.faq-cat-name::after` |
| **genuine text-contrast failures remaining** | **0** | |

Nothing in that table is unclassified. If a future run produces a row that does
not fall into one of these classes, it is a real failure until proven otherwise.

## Three defects the audit found, all fixed

1. **`.fc-pill.critical` failed G1 at 3.95:1.** `.fc-pill` is `--fs-2xs`, so it
   needs 4.5:1. Its siblings already used paired status tokens — `--warn-text`
   exists precisely because `--warn` failed at 3.1:1 — but `.critical` used raw
   `#fde8e8` and `var(--red)` and was missed. Now uses `--red-bg` /
   `--status-text-danger`: **4.51:1**, and 6.27:1 under high contrast. That is a
   narrow margin and worth revisiting if the palette moves.
2. **`.yn-display input` and its `:focus-visible` partner** — `color:#fff` on a
   control whose surface is now `#ffffff`. Dead: the click-to-type year editor
   was removed and no markup renders an input there.
3. **`.yn-gear`** — `color:#fff` with `rgba(255,255,255,.2)` borders, styled for
   the dark year capsule the redesign replaced. No markup uses it.

(2) and (3) are the same story: a container changed from dark to light and its
children kept white-on-white styling. They were invisible to review because the
elements are never rendered — only a contrast register that enumerates *rules*
rather than *screens* surfaces them.

## What is still not measured

The gates below need a running browser or a person, and none of them are claimed
here:

- **G3 200% text**, **G4 keyboard operability**, **G5 hit targets**,
  **G6 gesture alternatives**, **G11 semantics** — structural audits not yet run
  against every screen.
- **The 721 unresolved pairs.** Closing them means pairing by hand or teaching
  the tool `color-mix()` and `data-theme`.
- **The Planning Workspace contrast register.** Its styling is largely inline and
  in component files, which `css_audit.py` cannot enumerate; its token inventory
  is here, its contrast register is not.
- **Any human test.** No 5-second test, first-click test or task-completion
  study has been run. HUMAN VALIDATION PENDING.
